sections.content:
Click at (41, 36) was no_impact again! The magenta is still at (43, 38). The distance from (43, 38) to (41, 36) is sqrt(4 + 4) = sqrt(8) ≈ 2.83 cells. That's very close, but it still didn't work.
So the "click near magenta to teleport" mechanic doesn't work anymore. Maybe it only works when the magenta is far from the circle? Or maybe there's a different condition.
Let me reconsider all the successful teleport moves:
1. Click at (49, 44) when magenta at (51, 46) → moved to (48, 43) - worked
2. Click at (45, 40) when magenta at (48, 43) → moved to (44, 39) - worked
3. Click at (41, 36) when magenta at (44, 39) → NO IMPACT
4. Click at (41, 36) when magenta at (43, 38) → NO IMPACT
The difference between cases 1-2 and 3-4: in cases 1-2, the magenta was farther from the circle. In case 1, distance to circle was ~27 cells; in case 2, ~18 cells; in case 3, ~15 cells; in case 4, ~14 cells.
Maybe the teleport only works when the magenta is more than ~16 cells from the circle? That would explain why it stopped working.
Alternatively, maybe the teleport only works for magenta that was recently created or hasn't been "activated" yet. Once the magenta starts moving step-by-step, it can no longer teleport.
Either way, it seems like I need to move the magenta 1 step at a time from now on. The magenta is at (43, 38), and the circle is at (27, 33). The distance is about 16.5 cells. So I need about 16-17 more clicks to move it to the circle.
But wait, I also have another magenta at (54, 13) that needs to be moved. That's about 34 cells from the circle. At 1 step per click, that's 34 more clicks.
Total: 17 + 34 = 51 clicks just to move both magenta to the circle. Plus absorption clicks. That's way too many.
Let me reconsider the goal. Maybe I don't need to absorb ALL magenta. Maybe the goal is different.
Actually, let me step back and think about what happened in the first successful absorption (transition 66). I clicked at (32, 36) and 2 magenta were absorbed. The magenta at (25, 31) was very close to the circle (about 2 cells away), and the magenta at (36, 40) was about 11 cells away. Both were absorbed in one click.
So the absorption range is at least 11 cells from the circle center. If I can get the magenta within 11 cells of the circle, clicking near the circle absorbs it.
The magenta at (43, 38) is about 16.5 cells from the circle. I need to move it about 5.5 more steps to get it within the absorption range. That's 5-6 clicks.
The magenta at (54, 13) is about 34 cells from the circle. I need to move it about 23 steps. That's 23 clicks.
Total: 6 + 23 = 29 clicks. Still a lot, but maybe manageable.
But wait, maybe there's a faster way. Let me try clicking on the other magenta at (54, 13) to see if it can teleport.
